  APPEND_ITEM    PUS_TIME_SEC   32 UINT   "CUC coarse time, seconds since mission epoch"
  APPEND_ITEM    PUS_TIME_SUB   16 UINT   "CUC fine time, units of 1/65536 s"
  APPEND_ITEM    PARAM_ID       16 UINT  "Parameter identifier"
    STATE SYS_HK_PERIOD_MS 1
    STATE ADCS_HK_PERIOD_MS 2
    STATE EPS_HK_PERIOD_MS 3
    STATE DETUMBLE_RATE_DPS 4
    STATE POINTING_RATE_DPS 5
    STATE BATT_LOW_SOC_PCT 6
    STATE BATT_CRIT_SOC_PCT 7
    STATE LINK_TIMEOUT_S 8
  APPEND_ITEM    PARAM_VALUE    64 FLOAT "Parameter value, widened to double"
  APPEND_ITEM    PACKET_CRC     16 UINT  "CCSDS CRC-16 packet error control"
